page.overview:
Who is Ardin?

If spoken to, will tell that use to keep their skin beautiful. Depending on the time of day, she will also remark that has a lot of energy being awake this early, if spoken to in the morning, or comment on the temperature if spoken to around noon or in the evening.

As a , is very keen to sell her wares, with her tactics ranging from persuasion to telling tall and implausible lies in order to make some money. If purchases all of the from her stall she will pretend her stall is full of rare and mysterious , that are only visible to the most beautiful. If talks to her about this, she will admit that after he bought all her she had nothing left to restock her stall with, but she think people will fall for this. However, she promises to restock her soon. She does in fact manage to convince both and , although the latter requires ’s help.

Despite her trickery, is genuinely interested in and will tell facts about them, such as that they enjoy the cool weather. She encourages to take an interest in them despite not being an expert herself, quietly admitting that although there is lots of interesting information about mushrooms she does not understand a lot of it.

When makes a purchase from , she may encourage him to use the nearby kitchen for . Like other , can sell his own to . When she buys an from , will thank him.
